tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures favor the coupled siphon-memory ODE, and the pilot horizons already bracket the target H = 0.46. The trajectory batch adds observations of the transient and brings the fit to at least eight rows, helping distinguish memory decay from coupling before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoints for five unknowns leave no residual degrees of freedom. The similar horizons also make it hard to separate memory coupling strength from its decay time.
It costs less but does not resolve the ambiguity in the coupled transient.
Neither uses the initial pool state, memory state, or sink gradient, so neither accounts for the observed signatures.
